title: drag-lint Graph (dockable)
summary: Opens the drag-lint graph viewer as a dockable window inside the IDE, so it can sit beside Structure
intro: Read this when you want the graph viewer to stay docked in the IDE, for example beside the Structure form, instead of floating. Choose drag-lint > drag-lint Graph (dockable); it needs the plugin loaded and drag_lint_graph.exe deployed beside it.

steps: The graph viewer opens as a dockable window; drag it where you want it to stay docked

questions.ask: How do I keep the graph viewer docked beside the Structure form?
